Dummifying: 

```{python}
enc=OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore')

enc_fitted=enc.fit(penguins[['species']]) #only dummifying/transforming the one desired column 
enc_fitted.transform(penguins[['species']]).todense() #note that this "spits out" a numpy matrix and not a dataframe 
```



Standardizing: 

```{python}
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler 
scaler=StandardScaler()
```

```{python}
scaler_fitted=scaler.fit(penguins[['bill_length_mm']]) #looks at this column and asks, what is the mean and what is the standard deviation 
scaler_fitted.transform(penguins[['bill_length_mm']])
```

This essentially measures how many SDs above and or below the mean
